headlines.text: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq slide to open the week as traders brace for Nvidia earnings, Anthropic's IPO and Fed minutes
Nvidia shares fall as Jensen Huang's allies push a comeback campaign backed by Elon Musk, ahead of its first earnings call without him Tuesday
Baird slashes its Nvidia price target 60% citing Huang-exit risk and slowing AI spending, even as shares attempt a rebound
Anthropic sets IPO price range at $70-$78 a share, targeting up to a $1.4 trillion valuation backed by $26B from Nvidia, Google and Microsoft
US weighs tighter chip-export curbs on China as Commerce Department moves to close licensing loopholes for Nvidia's AI chips
Fed's October meeting minutes, due out Wednesday, will offer fresh clues ahead of the December 9 rate decision
